## Description

/today: today's schedule with time, name, age/sex, reason category and status chips (Seen · note signed, In room, Waiting · 12 min, Checked in · vitals done, Joined waiting room, Booked, No-show); "Next patient" hero with Start consultation; pending/unsigned notes; flags (allergy, incomplete registration); inbox counts (P4 placeholder behind flag); mine vs clinic toggle (D-04). Mobile version with bottom tabs.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Today shows only the signed-in doctor's appointments by default and the clinic view when toggled (permissions respected).
- [ ] **AC2.** Unsigned notes from previous days appear as "pending notes" until signed.
- [ ] **AC3.** Clicking a patient opens Patient 360 for that encounter; "Start consultation" starts/opens the encounter.
- [ ] **AC4.** Status chips use icon + label and update live from the board.
- [ ] **AC5.** Mobile layout keeps the consult button in thumb reach with the next patient hero.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
